turns.reply:
I solved level 3 of task-5f650ec8 in 146 actions. The human baseline is 179.

How the level works:
- Each move shifts the block by 6 cells.
- Action 5 ends the current run and starts a new block at the start spot. All earlier runs then replay as ghost blocks, step for step, at the same time as the new block.
- An 8 shape moves back along its track only while a block stays on it. When the block leaves, it springs back.
- Holding the right 8 shape opens the b gate. Holding the lower end of the left 8 shape opens the way up into the 9 frame.

The solution uses three runs:
1. Run 1: `1,1,4,4,4,4,2,2,2,2,4,5` puts the block on the right 8 shape to hold the gate open.
2. Run 2: `3` (a wall bump, used as a one-step delay), then `1,1`, `4`×7, `2`×7, `3`×5, `5` puts the block on the lower end of the left 8 shape. Without the delay, this ghost blocked the bottom path before the last block got past.
3. Run 3: `1,1`, `4`×7, `2`×7, `3`×7, `1,1,1,4,4,1,1` goes into the frame and completes the level.

About 80 of the 146 actions went to exploring and two level resets. The clean solution is about 64 actions. I saved it as a global memory ("5f650ec8 L3 SOLVED") for when this level comes back.
